import re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('main/zigbee_gateway.c')
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
pat=re.compile(r'^(?:static\s+)?(?:[A-Za-z_][\w\s\*]*?)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(')
starts=[]
for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
    s=line.strip()
    if s.startswith(('if ','if(', 'for ','for(', 'while ','while(', 'switch ','return ')):
        continue
    m=pat.match(s)
    if m and not s.endswith(';'):
        starts.append((i,m.group(1)))
for n,(start,name) in enumerate(starts):
    end=(starts[n+1][0]-1) if n+1<len(starts) else len(lines)
    span=end-start+1
    print(f'{start:4d}-{end:4d} {span:4d} {name}')
print('function_count=',len(starts))
print('functions_over_60_lines=',sum(1 for n,(s,_) in enumerate(starts) if ((starts[n+1][0]-1 if n+1<len(starts) else len(lines))-s+1)>60))
